problem_type: Canvas instructional guidance without interaction context
symptom: Every empty node in a group repeats its type, status and next-step actions.
direct_cause: PendingGenerationPlaceholder only records selected as a data attribute; other empty renderers have no selection input.
class_root: The shared empty-state boundary has no distinction between instructional guidance and operational state, nor a host-owned single-selection gate.
affected_population: Creators browsing dense groups and mixed node types
Unselected, multiselected, and read-only canvas nodes
entry_points: NodeEmptyState -> media, upload, text, audio, panorama, whiteboard
internal_only_reason: This is Nomi internal canvas interaction and approved visual behavior; installed React/XYFlow APIs are unchanged.
invariants: Only the host primary selection expands instructional guidance.
Operational state and authored/result content remain visible independent of selection; added empty-card titles apply only to idle nodes without results.
Upload/launcher activation requires permission at pointerdown, not only at click.
Node type icons use the existing registry; legacy prop renderKind keeps its semantic box.
LOD icon bounds must fit the actual media body; short bodies use the existing compact vertical center.

door_reduction.why_not: All five prior visual consumer doors remain for distinct media/editor bodies; new doors connect specialized director/clip/LOD and host context. No caller owns its own guidance visibility. Launcher and Pending wrappers are included to count the extra hop to Base/whiteboard/lab. Context value/provider wiring is counted explicitly.

generality_proof: A context provided around every React Flow node carries the existing primarySelection verdict. NodeEmptyState removes instructional text/actions when it is false; explicit status purpose bypasses only that presentation rule. Upload and launcher consumers admit activation from the same context at gesture start.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Carry the host selection and read-only verdict without renderer-specific inference.
Project instructional content into icon-only or full guidance; preserve explicit operational status.
Provide authoritative primary selection and read-only context to every built-in renderer.
Admit at pointerdown; preserve that verdict through label-to-input forwarded clicks; cancel and read-only fail closed.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Media placeholders converge on NodeEmptyState; waiting/derivedReady become explicit status.
Empty text overlay consumes NodeEmptyState while EditorContent and processing footer remain intact.
Empty upload label consumes shared presentation and activation gate; playback/subtitles unchanged.
No-source, breakdown progress and failure are operational facts, not instructional placeholders.
Missing artifact metadata is diagnostic content, not an ordinary empty node.

recurrence.reason: Every new node kind and group can repeat the same instructional block without a common interaction contract.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs NodeEmptyState (5 direct consumers, 9 call sites)
Independent V-node-guidance census traversed all registry kinds, specialized hosts, LOD and selection adapters.

prevention.invariant: Instructional text and actions are absent outside primary selection; status content is explicitly classified.
prevention.failure_mode: No host selection context defaults to icon-only, read-only presentation; changed regression matrix fails if text/actions leak.
prevention.strategy: Converge every ordinary empty body on host-owned context and one presentation boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove unconditional per-card guidance and hand-written generic-media icon fallback in the same change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party defect or dependency transition; this is an internal presentation invariant using existing React context and XYFlow selection.

migration: No persistent schema/state change; existing projects derive the new presentation from current selection.
residual_risks: Windows native upload dialogs and paid generation are not exercised by this presentation-only change; operational generation code remains unchanged.
